name: Hideous Instakill
description: This "I Wanna be The Guy" inspired fps contains light metroidvania elements, a ton of flashing lights, and a lot of rage in your future.
contribution: This was what taught me ProBuilder's new interface in Unity!~
Pretty much all coding beyond what unity gave out of the box
I wrote the music; it's actually one of the first songs I ever wrote :D
notes: This is the first truly 3D game I have compeleted. While yes Highway to Hell uses 3D visuals, you could display this game 1-1 using purely 2D top down assets, so I don't consider it a real 3D game.
This is THE MOST CRUNCHED project here with almost the entire thing being made in less than 3 days and a combined 8 hours of sleep.

I think one of the most interesting things I pulled off with this one is how I handled the environment, while yes every wall and floor has a the same texture, thinks like honkey geometry in the sewers or tinting in the lab did wonders for making each area still feel like it had it's own identity in some shape or form
